themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Far-right and right-wing parties across Europe are leveraging border crises to advocate for stricter immigration controls. In Spain, Vox demands coalition governments to address migration surges, while Italy's Fratelli d'Italia and Lega emphasize border security as a national priority. Similar rhetoric is echoed in France by Rassemblement National, highlighting a shared transnational strategy to exploit migration for political gain.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments in Argentina, Hungary, and the UK are advancing austerity measures and welfare reforms, sparking fiscal debates and public backlash. Argentina's La Libertad Avanza pushes budget cuts and deregulation, while Hungary's Tisza government suspends social programs. In the UK, Reform UK proposes £50bn in welfare cuts, reflecting a broader trend of reducing state spending under right-wing leadership.

themes.title: Trump administration targets gender-affirming care and LGBTQ+ rights
themes.blurb: The Trump administration is intensifying efforts to restrict gender-affirming care and LGBTQ+ rights in the U.S., with parallel actions in Poland and Hungary. Policies include investigations into hospitals providing transgender care, executive orders splitting childhood vaccines, and legal challenges to LGBTQ+ protections. These actions reflect a coordinated transnational push against gender-affirming healthcare and LGBTQ+ rights.

themes.title: AfD surge reshapes German politics ahead of regional elections
themes.blurb: Germany's AfD is leading polls in Saxony-Anhalt and other eastern states, reshaping regional politics with proposals to abolish domestic intelligence agencies, end school inclusion, and enforce remigration policies. The party's rise is sparking debates over democracy, cultural identity, and tactical voting strategies among mainstream parties.

themes.title: Javier Milei's economic policies spark controversy and protests
themes.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei faces growing backlash over his economic policies, including deregulation, austerity, and privatization. Protests and declining approval ratings highlight public dissatisfaction, while political alliances with PRO and internal tensions within La Libertad Avanza complicate his re-election prospects. Milei's policies are closely watched by right-wing leaders in the U.S. and Italy for their potential impact on global economic trends.
